```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

raw_countries <- fromJSON(
  "https://gitlab.com/restcountries/restcountries/-/raw/master/src/main/resources/countriesV3.1.json",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

country_facts <- map_dfr(raw_countries, \(c) {
  code <- tolower(c$cca2 %||% "")
  langs <- if (!is.null(c$languages)) paste(unlist(c$languages), collapse = ", ") else "None listed"
  currs <- if (!is.null(c$currencies)) {
    map_chr(c$currencies, \(cur) paste0(cur$name, if (!is.null(cur$symbol)) paste0(" (", cur$symbol, ")") else "")) |>
      paste(collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "None"
  }
  cap <- if (!is.null(c$capital) && length(c$capital) > 0) paste(unlist(c$capital), collapse = ", ") else "No official capital"
  alt <- c$flags$alt %||% ""
  tld <- if (!is.null(c$tld) && length(c$tld) > 0) c$tld[[1]] else "N/A"
  demonym <- c$demonyms$eng$m %||% "N/A"
  tz <- if (!is.null(c$timezones) && length(c$timezones) > 0) paste(head(unlist(c$timezones), 2), collapse = ", ") else "UTC"
  borders_n <- if (!is.null(c$borders)) length(c$borders) else 0L
  lat <- if (!is.null(c$latlng) && length(c$latlng) >= 2) c$latlng[[1]] else 0
  lng <- if (!is.null(c$latlng) && length(c$latlng) >= 2) c$latlng[[2]] else 0

  tibble(
    code = code,
    name = c$name$common %||% code,
    official_name = c$name$official %||% "",
    capital = cap,
    region = c$region %||% "Other",
    subregion = c$subregion %||% "",
    population = format(c$population %||% 0, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
    area = paste0(format(c$area %||% 0, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), " km²"),
    languages = langs,
    currencies = currs,
    car_side = str_to_title(c$car$side %||% "right"),
    demonym = demonym,
    tld = tld,
    timezone = tz,
    borders = ifelse(borders_n == 0, "Island / No land borders", paste0(borders_n, " neighboring countries")),
    un_status = ifelse(isTRUE(c$unMember), "UN Member State", "Territory / Observer"),
    start_of_week = str_to_title(c$startOfWeek %||% "Monday"),
    coat_of_arms = c$coatOfArms$png %||% "",
    map_url = paste0("https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=", lat, "&mlon=", lng, "#map=5/", lat, "/", lng),
    flag_fact = if (nzchar(alt)) alt else paste0("This is the official flag of ", c$name$common, ".")
  )
})

uk_nations <- tibble(
  code = c("gb-eng", "gb-nir", "gb-sct", "gb-wls"),
  name = c("England", "Northern Ireland", "Scotland", "Wales"),
  official_name = c("England", "Northern Ireland", "Scotland", "Wales"),
  capital = c("London", "Belfast", "Edinburgh", "Cardiff"),
  region = "Europe",
  subregion = "Northern Europe (UK)",
  population = c("57,106,000", "1,910,000", "5,447,000", "3,132,000"),
  area = c("130,279 km²", "14,130 km²", "77,933 km²", "20,779 km²"),
  languages = c("English", "English, Irish, Ulster Scots", "English, Scots, Scottish Gaelic", "English, Welsh"),
  currencies = "British pound (£)",
  car_side = "Left",
  demonym = c("English", "Northern Irish", "Scottish", "Welsh"),
  tld = c(".uk / .eng", ".uk", ".scot / .uk", ".wales / .cymru"),
  timezone = "UTC+00:00",
  borders = c("2 (Scotland, Wales)", "1 (Republic of Ireland)", "1 (England)", "1 (England)"),
  un_status = "UK Constituent Country",
  start_of_week = "Monday",
  coat_of_arms = "",
  map_url = c(
    "https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=6/52.5/-1.5",
    "https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=7/54.6/-6.7",
    "https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=6/56.8/-4.2",
    "https://www.openstreetmap.org/#map=7/52.3/-3.8"
  ),
  flag_fact = c(
    "The St George's Cross features a bold red cross on a white field and has been England's national emblem since the Middle Ages.",
    "Historic banner associated with Northern Ireland featuring the Red Hand of Ulster inside a six-pointed star beneath a crown on a St George's cross.",
    "The Saltire (St Andrew's Cross) features a white diagonal cross on a sky-blue field and is one of the oldest national flags still in use.",
    "Y Ddraig Goch ('The Red Dragon') shows a fierce red dragon passant on a green and white field, used as a symbol of Wales for centuries."
  )
)

all_facts <- bind_rows(country_facts, uk_nations)

flag_files <- tibble(file = list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$")) |>
  mutate(code = str_remove(file, "\\.png$")) |>
  left_join(all_facts, by = "code") |>
  arrange(name)

ojs_define(flags_data = flag_files)
```

```{ojs}
flags = transpose(flags_data)

regionColors = ({
  "Americas": { bg: "rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.18)", border: "#f43f5e", text: "#fda4af" },
  "Europe":   { bg: "rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18)", border: "#3b82f6", text: "#93c5fd" },
  "Asia":     { bg: "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18)", border: "#f59e0b", text: "#fcd34d" },
  "Africa":   { bg: "rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18)", border: "#10b981", text: "#6ee7b7" },
  "Oceania":  { bg: "rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18)", border: "#a855f7", text: "#d8b4fe" },
  "Antarctic":{ bg: "rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.18)",  border: "#06b6d4", text: "#67e8f9" }
})

mutable selected = flags.find(d => d.code === "jp") || flags[0]
mutable discovered = new Set(["jp"])
mutable revealAll = false

// Spotlight / Reveal Card
{
  const rc = regionColors[selected.region] || { bg: "rgba(148,163,184,0.2)", border: "#94a3b8", text: "#cbd5e1" };

  return html`<div class="hero-card" style="border-top: 4px solid ${rc.border};">
    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2rem; align-items: center;">
      
      <!-- Flag & Coat of Arms column -->
      <div style="flex: 0 0 310px; text-align: center;">
        <div style="
          background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0%, rgba(15,23,42,0.6) 100%);
          padding: 14px;
          border-radius: 16px;
          border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
          box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        ">
          <img src="w2560/${selected.file}" alt="Flag of ${selected.name}" style="
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 195px;
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 8px;
          ">
        </div>

        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 0.85rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
          <span style="
            background: ${rc.bg};
            border: 1px solid ${rc.border};
            color: ${rc.text};
            padding: 3px 12px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
          ">${selected.region}</span>
          <span style="
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
            padding: 3px 10px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: #cbd5e1;
          ">ISO: <code>${selected.code.toUpperCase()}</code></span>
          <a href="${selected.map_url}" target="_blank" style="
            background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid #38bdf8;
            color: #7dd3fc;
            padding: 3px 12px;
            border-radius: 999px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            text-decoration: none;

          ">🗺️ View on Map ↗</a>
        </div>

      <!-- Country Details & Fun Facts column -->
      <div style="flex: 1 1 360px;">
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
          <div>
            <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: -0.02em;">
              ${selected.name}
            </h2>
            <div style="color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.95rem; margin-top: 2px;">
              ${selected.official_name} • <span style="color: #38bdf8;">${selected.un_status}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          ${selected.coat_of_arms ? html`<img src="${selected.coat_of_arms}" title="National Coat of Arms" style="height: 62px; width: auto; object-fit: contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.25));">` : ""}
        </div>

        <!-- Flag Symbolism & Story Box -->
        <div style="
          background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.18), rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.14));
          border-left: 4px solid #60a5fa;

          <div class="stat-tile">
            <div class="stat-label">🧭 Borders</div>
            <div class="stat-value">${selected.borders}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-tile">
            <div class="stat-label">🚗 Drives On / 🌐 Domain</div>
            <div class="stat-value">${selected.car_side} side • <code>${selected.tld}</code></div>
          </div>
          <div class="stat-tile">
            <div class="stat-label">⏰ Timezone & Week Start</div>
            <div class="stat-value">${selected.timezone} (${selected.start_of_week})</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Interactive Toolbar: Surprise Me, Quiz/Reveal toggle, and Discovery Tracker
{
  const bar = html`<div style="
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.75);
    border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
    padding: 0.9rem 1.25rem;
    border-radius: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  ">
    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.65rem; align-items: center;">
      <button class="action-btn" id="random-btn" style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #8b5cf6); color: white;">
        🎲 Surprise Me!
      </button>
      <button class="action-btn" id="reveal-btn" style="background: ${revealAll ? "#10b981" : "#334155"}; color: white; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);">
        ${revealAll ? "🙈 Hide Names (Mystery Mode)" : "👁️ Reveal All Country Names"}
      </button>
    </div>
    <div style="
      background: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid #facc15;
      color: #fde047;
      padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    ">
      🏆 Flags Discovered: ${discovered.size} / ${flags.length}
    </div>
  </div>`;

  bar.querySelector("#random-btn").onclick = () => {
    const pick = flags[Math.floor(Math.random() * flags.length)];
    mutable selected = pick;
    discovered.add(pick.code);
    mutable discovered = new Set(discovered);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  bar.querySelector("#reveal-btn").onclick = () => {
    mutable revealAll = !revealAll;
  };

  return bar;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof region_filter = Inputs.radio(
  ["All Regions", "Americas", "Europe", "Asia", "Africa", "Oceania", "Antarctic"],
  { label: "🌍 Region:", value: "All Regions" }
)

viewof search_query = Inputs.text({
  label: "🔍 Search:",
  placeholder: "Search by country, capital, or language (reveals matching flags)..."
})
```

```{ojs}
filtered_flags = flags.filter(d => {
  const matchesRegion = region_filter === "All Regions" || d.region === region_filter;
  const q = search_query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const matchesSearch = !q ||
    d.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    d.capital.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    d.languages.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
    d.code.toLowerCase().includes(q);
  return matchesRegion && matchesSearch;
})

{
  const grid = html`<div style="
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(105px, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  "></div>`;

  for (const item of filtered_flags) {
    const isSelected = item.code === selected.code;
    const isRevealed = revealAll || isSelected || discovered.has(item.code) || search_query.trim().length > 0;
    const rc = regionColors[item.region] || { bg: "rgba(148,163,184,0.15)", border: "#64748b", text: "#cbd5e1" };

    const card = html`<button class="mini-flag-btn" title="Click to reveal country & fun facts!" style="
      background: ${isSelected
        ? "linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.45), rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.45))"
        : isRevealed
        ? "rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9)"
        : "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.75)"};
      border: ${isSelected
        ? "2px solid #38bdf8"
        : isRevealed
        ? `1px solid ${rc.border}`
        : "1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)"};
      box-shadow: ${isSelected ? "0 0 18px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)" : "0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)"};
    ">
      <img src="w2560/${item.file}" loading="lazy" style="
        width: 82px;
        height: 54px;
        object-fit: contain;
        border-radius: 4px;
        filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
      ">
      <span style="
        margin-top: 8px;
        font-size: 0.76rem;
        font-weight: ${isRevealed ? "700" : "600"};
        color: ${isSelected ? "#ffffff" : isRevealed ? rc.text : "#64748b"};
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.15;
      ">${isRevealed ? item.name : "❓ Guess Me"}</span>
    </button>`;

    card.onclick = () => {
      mutable selected = item;
      discovered.add(item.code);
      mutable discovered = new Set(discovered);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
    };
    grid.appendChild(card);
  }

  return grid;
}
```
